OpenSearch Serverless collections come prepackaged with the following plugins from the
OpenSearch community. Serverless automatically deploys and manages plugins for you.
Analysis plugins
• ICU Analysis
• Japanese (kuromoji) Analysis
Supported OpenSearch plugins
591

Developer Guide

Mapper plugins

• Mapper Murmur3
• Mapper Annotated Text
Scripting plugins
• Painless
• Expression
• Mustache
In addition, OpenSearch Serverless includes all plugins that ship as modules.
